text.en: Common stair tread at least 0.3 m
text.ru: Проступь общей лестницы не менее 0.3 м

source.paraphrase: Shared or public stairs have treads of at least 0.30 m, with twice the riser plus tread between 0.62 and 0.64 m.

text.en: Common stair flight width at least 1.2 m
text.ru: Ширина марша общей лестницы не менее 1.2 м

source.paraphrase: Shared or public stair flights are at least 1.20 m wide.

text.en: Stair tread in a house at least 0.25 m
text.ru: Проступь в доме не менее 0.25 м

source.paraphrase: Private-dwelling stairs have a minimum going of 0.25 m.

text.en: Stair flight width in a house at least 0.8 m
text.ru: Ширина марша в доме не менее 0.8 м

source.paraphrase: Stairs inside a private dwelling are at least 0.80 m wide.

text.en: Clear height of habitable rooms at least 2.7 m
text.ru: Высота жилых помещений не менее 2.7 м

source.paraphrase: Habitable rooms need 2.70 m net height; corridors, bathrooms and storerooms 2.40 m; 2.55 m allowed above 1,000 m altitude.

text.en: Accessible-route corridor clear width at least 1.0 m
text.ru: Ширина коридора на доступном маршруте не менее 1.0 м

source.paraphrase: Corridors are at least 1.00 m wide with passing and turning widenings at the ends and about every 10 m.

text.en: Window area at least 12.5 % of the floor of a habitable room
text.ru: Площадь окон не менее 12.5 % площади пола жилой комнаты

source.paraphrase: Openable window area must be at least one eighth of floor area, with average daylight factor of about 2 percent.

text.en: Common stair riser at most 0.17 m (from the step rule)
text.ru: Подъём ступени общей лестницы не более 0.17 м (из правила шага)

source.clause: point 8.1.10, tread at least 30 cm and 2 risers + tread 62 to 64 cm
source.paraphrase: Common stair steps keep a constant ratio with treads of 30 cm and more.
source.note: derived by the editor from the read clause: tread minimum and 2 risers + tread at most 64 cm; the order states no riser number

text.en: Private stair riser at most 0.195 m (from the step rule)
text.ru: Подъём ступени внутренней лестницы не более 0.195 м (из правила шага)

source.clause: point 8.1.10, private stairs tread at least 25 cm, same step rule
source.paraphrase: Private stairs keep the step rule with treads of 25 cm and more.
source.note: derived by the editor from the read clause: tread minimum and 2 risers + tread at most 64 cm; the order states no riser number

text.en: Step rule: 2 risers + tread 0.62 to 0.64 m

source.clause: point 8.1.10, twice the riser plus the tread between 62 and 64 cm
source.paraphrase: Twice the riser plus the tread lies between 62 and 64 cm.
source.note: read 2026-11-15: unipr.it copy of the order of 14 June 1989 no. 236

text.en: Workroom clear height at least 3 m (local rules may allow less for offices)
text.ru: Высота рабочего помещения не менее 3 м (местные правила допускают меньше для офисов)

source.clause: annex IV 1.2.1.1, net height of closed workrooms at least 3 m
source.paraphrase: A closed workroom is at least 3 m high unless local rules allow less.
source.note: to_verify: number from the public decree as known to the editor; annex not opened in this pass

text.en: Office escape route at most 45 m to a safe place (30 m to a protected stair)
text.ru: Путь эвакуации в офисе не более 45 м до безопасной зоны (30 м до защищённой лестницы)

source.clause: escape routes, 45 m to a safe place, 30 m to a protected stair, dead ends 15 m
source.paraphrase: An office escape route reaches a safe place within 45 m.
source.note: to_verify: values from search summaries of the order; coordinated text not opened

rules.note: na: the workplace decree sets floor area per worker (2 m2 each, annex IV 1.2.1.3) and volume per worker (10 m3), not a minimum room area

text.en: No minimum office room area: the rule is area and volume per worker.
text.ru: Нет минимальной площади офиса: норма задаёт площадь и объём на работника.
